# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|----------|---------------------|
| tuning_mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| tuning_min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| lockbox_mean | 1.793 | 1.793 |
| lockbox_min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| worst_mdd | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Observations

1. **Champion Holds** - v5_latest maintains position due to superior tuning stability (min 0.43 vs 0.05) and better drawdown control

2. **Candidate Trade-off** - `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` shows better lockbox_min but unacceptable tuning_min variance and deeper drawdown

3. **System Health** - 187 loops completed, ~28h runway remaining, no stuck INCONCLUSIVE candidates

## Ready to Execute

```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Standing by to run commands or review `next_fix.md` output when generated.
